name: SC-04
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with R+11 partisan lean
Incumbent Timmons heavily outraised McClain ($1.6M vs $33K)
Prediction markets price Timmons near 95% to win
No public polling of the race
model.rationale: The R+11 lean, Timmons' incumbency and overwhelming fundraising advantage, and markets pricing him around 95% all point to a comfortable Republican hold, with McClain's minimal war chest offering no path to close the gap.
model.watch: Any late polling or outside spending against Timmons showing a tighter-than-expected race would be the main signal to revisit.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
South Carolina's 4th District leans strongly Republican, and incumbent William Timmons is seeking another term after easily securing renomination. Democrat Courtney McClain has raised only about $33,000 with minimal cash on hand, while Timmons has raised roughly $1.6 million and drawn nearly $500,000 in outside support. A Libertarian candidate is also on the ballot but is not a factor.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and prediction markets, which price Timmons near 95%. The district's lean and the incumbent's financial edge make a Democratic upset unlikely, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
